description: a path written with a backslash is covered only by the same text, so data\in.csv is outside a recorded prefix data even where \ separates directories
known_limit: A change that does not widen, reported as one, on Windows. A path holding a backslash is compared whole, because on Windows data/..\..\x leaves data; the price is that data\in.csv, which is inside data there, is reported too (velaris-spec open question Q7).
